decisions.reviewScope: Name, description, complete eligibility, other saved population/service evidence, all 25 group definitions

evidence.text:
**Eligibility Requirements**

Utah newborns; Utah law says every baby should be screened unless a religious opt-out form is signed.

**How to Best Connect**

for hospital births, follow the hospital and pediatrician’s second-screen instructions; for home births, the state page says families should order a kit at least three weeks before the due date and have the midwife collect and mail the sample.

**Access**

Hours and availability: Screen timing is newborn-specific: first screen at 1-2 days old and second screen at 7-16 days old; program office hours were not verified.

Utah screens for more than 40 rare genetic, metabolic, and hormonal disorders, requests further testing after abnormal or out-of-range results, and connects diagnosed babies with specialty medical providers.

**Important Information to Know**

the first screen does not replace the second screen; the home-birth kit cost shown on the state page was $148 and covers both tests, and families should use their clinician for medical interpretation and urgent symptoms. Source: https://newbornscreening.utah.gov/

**Eligibility Requirements**

Utah applicants must have no means to afford dental care and must be over 65, permanently disabled, or need medically necessary dental care.

**How to Best Connect**

use Dental Lifeline Network's Utah online application, download/mail the application, upload documents, or contact Utah coordinator Brandon Leviton at 801-499-6504.

**Access**

Hours and availability: Online and mail applications; coordinator hours are not published. All Utah counties were listed as open to new applications at this review.

statewide program administered through Dental Lifeline Network; care depends on being matched with volunteer dentists/labs and is not a St. George walk-in clinic.

**Important Information to Know**

volunteers provide comprehensive treatment but not emergency or cosmetic treatment; waits can be long and an open county does not guarantee quick local placement. evidence.text:
**Eligibility Requirements**

K.A.V.A. Talks is culturally focused on Pacific Islander men, but the current page says all men seeking education/support may attend and that monthly co-ed violence-prevention groups are held.

**How to Best Connect**

use the Google Meet link on the K.A.V.A. Talks page or dial +1 650-817-8227 with PIN 926333002; PIK2AR also points users to resource-request sign-up for resources and events.

**Access**

Hours and availability: Weekly Thursdays at 6:00 PM Mountain Time online; last Thursday monthly co-ed group per current page. Confirm current calendar before joining.

the program describes domestic-violence and sexual-assault awareness, prevention, trauma-informed culturally competent teaching, peer discussions, advocacy, and resource connection.

**Important Information to Know**

this is a prevention/peer-support and education group, not emergency shelter, confidential crisis response, or protective-order help. Survivors in immediate danger should use 911 or a DV hotline. Sources: https://www.pik2ar.org/kava-talks ; https://www.pik2ar.org/

**Eligibility Requirements**

complete FAFSA using school code 003671, call 435-652-7575, email finaid@utahtech.edu or visit Holland 180 during office hours.

Hours and availability: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM; closed Saturday-Sunday.

the current page verifies help and information for loans, scholarships, grants, work-study employment, student jobs, payment plans, financial-aid forms, scholarship opportunities and counselor questions; it notes the 2026-2027 FAFSA is open for Fall 2026, Spring 2027 and Summer 2027 aid, and that the 2027-2028 FAFSA is coming October 2026.

for the 2025 renter credit filed in 2026, applicants must be Utah renters or manufactured-homeowners renting a lot, have 2025 household income below $44,221, have been Utah residents for the full year, and be either at least age 66 or an unmarried surviving spouse. Applicants must be able to prove Utah residency and household income.

**How to Best Connect**

apply online at TAP by selecting File your current renter's credit, or submit Form TC-90CB to the Utah State Tax Commission; for help call 801-297-6254 or 1-800-662-4335 ext. 6254. Washington County residents can use the Hurricane Tax Commission office for local taxpayer assistance.

**Access**

Hours and availability: File online through TAP; Tax Commission offices are generally Monday-Friday 8 AM-5 PM and closed state holidays. Current-year renter-credit applications are due by December 31.

the credit is up to $1,412, based on income and rent paid, and the application deadline is December 31.

**Important Information to Know**

this is a tax credit/refund, not immediate rent assistance; income tables and credit amounts can change annually; renters apply through the State Tax Commission, not the county auditor. Sources: https://tax.utah.gov/forms-pubs/pub-36/ ; https://tax.utah.gov/relief/homeowner-renter-relief/ ; https://tax.utah.gov/contact/

evidence.text:
**Eligibility Requirements**

The St. George Meals on Wheels page says the program is for people age 60 or older who cannot leave home without assistance and cannot drive. Suggested donation is listed as $4 per meal. Source: https://coa.washco.utah.gov/st-george/meals-on-wheels/

**How to Best Connect**

Call the St. George Active Life Center at 435-301-7294 option 2, or ask for Linda, to verify eligibility and sign up.

**Access**

Hours and availability: Deliveries Tuesday-Friday, generally 10 AM-2 PM; Friday can include two meals by request.

Meals are delivered Tuesday-Friday from about 10 AM to 2 PM. Friday deliveries can include two meals if requested. The St. George Active Life Center serves the area from Coral Canyon to Gunlock, with Meals on Wheels available throughout Washington County through senior centers. The page says an outreach worker will visit within the first two weeks after sign-up.

**Important Information to Know**

This is not same-day emergency groceries and requires eligibility verification before delivery starts. Confirm current route coverage, donation policy, start date, dietary accommodations, and whether there is a waitlist.

The property site describes Summit Pointe as a 55+ senior community. Call the property or use the property website contact route to schedule a tour or ask about application requirements. Source: https://www.summitpointeseniorapartments.com/

Hours and availability: Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-6:00 PM; Saturday 10:00 AM-5:00 PM; Sunday closed, per property site. Call to confirm current leasing hours.
